data.name: Tale of Chak Chak
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Chak Chak is a wholesome cozy game filled with interactive mini-games inspired by mindfulness practices. Players journey through a magical book that tells Chak Chak’s story as she searches for inner peace and true happiness. Along the way, players complete relaxing mini-games to create aura for Chak Chak, helping her move forward through her journey.

Gameplay Overview

  • Mindfulness Mini-Games – Enjoy calming activities inspired by breathing, grounding, and simple mindfulness exercises designed to relax, comfort, and uplift.

  • Book-Based Progression – Each chapter of the storybook introduces new cozy locations, charming friends, and gentle challenges as Chak Chak’s journey unfolds.

  • Exploration & Interaction – Discover hidden details, interact with the environment, and explore beautiful hand-crafted worlds filled with warmth and wonder.

  • Relaxed Pace – No timers, no pressure — experience the story and mini-games entirely at your own rhythm.

Key Features

  • Single-player, narrative-driven cozy adventure

  • Mindfulness-inspired mini-games woven into a meaningful story

  • Accessible and intuitive gameplay designed for all ages

  • Hand-painted visuals with a soothing original soundtrack

  • Approximately 1 hour of gameplay with replayable mini-games

  • A comforting experience focused on peace, positivity, and emotional warmth


    Credits
    This game was brought to life through the creativity and dedication of a wonderful team:

    Game Development by Zeynab Mirzadeh
    Business Development by Hadi Ghasemi Nanesa
    Original Music & Vocals by Léa Jouffrieau
    3D Art by Shahin Ghasemi Nejad
    2D Art Mohammadali Hasan Pour

With deep appreciation for their talent and passion.

data.short_description: Help Chak Chak on a heartwarming journey of friendship, self-discovery, and finding true happiness. Play mindfulness-inspired mini-games, grow her aura, and explore a charming cozy world filled with warmth, joy, and meaningful moments.
